data.name: 9 Yin Sutra: Immortal
data.detailed_description:
9 Yin Sutra: Immortal is an open-world cultivation sandbox blending survival, building, exploration, talisman arts, and artifact crafting.

As spiritual qi rises, all things awaken to the path of cultivation. Step into a vast realm brought to life with Unreal Engine 5, where cultivators from around the world gather to discuss the Dao and seek eternal life. Uncover hidden realms, seize rare opportunities, decipher ancient runes, and refine wondrous treasures. In a world where danger and fortune walk side by side, how far will you go to uncover the secret of immortality?

KEY FEATURES

A World Awakened by Qi

Cross-platform progression lets your journey continue wherever you play. Explore a world where creations from many cultural traditions coexist, meet fellow cultivators from across the globe, exchange insights on the Dao, and share the joy of cultivation.

A Vast Realm Between Heaven and Earth

Explore an open world spanning more than 1,600 square kilometers, realized with Unreal Engine 5 and next-generation technology. Take to the skies on a flying sword, cross seas of cloud, witness celestial phenomena, and gaze down upon the mortal world from the heavens.

Countless Paths to Immortality

All beings yearn to transcend. Some seek truth in the boundless world; others turn inward to master the self. Humans and spirits alike can cultivate: draw in qi, defy the heavens, and pursue eternal life. Temper your body, refine your qi, or walk a path all your own. Among the three thousand paths of the Dao, every road may lead to immortality.

Inscribe Runes. Seize Your Fortune.

Seek out mysterious symbols and seize the opportunities fate places in your path. Shape runes through incantations, then inscribe them upon almost anything, imbuing ordinary objects with extraordinary talismanic power.

Worlds Within Worlds

The vast can hide within the small, and the small can contain the vast. Awaken spatial arts through divine sense, then shrink and store almost anything, from towering sect buildings to needles, thread, and seeds, all within a space that fits in your palm.

Refine the Essence of Creation

Forge artifacts, brew elixirs, and craft talismans through a highly flexible refinement system. Master material ratios and multi-step processes, fuse materials within the furnace, and draw out the hidden essence of all things.
